---
title: "Billionaires, Foundations, and the Giving Pledge"
subtitle: "Tracking the growth of private philanthropy, 2010–2025"
date: "2026-06-14"
categories: [Data Story, Global Development, Philanthropy, Billionaires, Giving Pledge]
---

<span class="kicker">Data Story &nbsp;·&nbsp; Giving Pledge &middot; Candid &middot; UBS/Forbes &nbsp;·&nbsp; 2010&#8211;2025</span>

::: {.lead}
In 2010, Bill Gates, Melinda French Gates, and Warren Buffett launched the Giving Pledge,
asking the world's wealthiest people to commit at least half their fortunes to charity.
Fifteen years on, the number of billionaires has nearly tripled and the number of
private foundations has more than doubled — but the Giving Pledge itself has lost momentum,
with new sign-ups slowing to a trickle even as the fortunes it was designed to redirect
keep growing.
:::

```{=html}
<!-- ── CHART 1: GIVING PLEDGE SIGNATORIES ── -->
<p class="phil-h2">1 &mdash; The Giving Pledge: Cumulative Signatories</p>
<p class="phil-desc">
  The pledge grew quickly in its first decade, then stalled. Just 4 new signatories joined
  in 2024 — a record low — before a modest rebound to 14 in 2025. Today the pledge counts
  256 signatories from roughly 30 countries, of whom about 110 are US billionaires —
  roughly 12% of America's billionaire population.
</p>
<div class="phil-wrap">
  <canvas id="phil-pledge" height="320"></canvas>
</div>
<p class="phil-note">
  Cumulative signatories to the Giving Pledge by year. Compiled from the Giving Pledge
  public signatory list, the Institute for Policy Studies report "The Giving Pledge at 15"
  (2025), and contemporaneous press coverage. Figures for individual years are
  approximate, interpolated between known totals.
</p>

<!-- ── CHART 2: US PRIVATE FOUNDATIONS ── -->
<p class="phil-h2">2 &mdash; Number of US Private Foundations</p>
<p class="phil-desc">
  While headline philanthropy debates focus on a handful of billionaire names, the
  private foundation sector has quietly more than doubled in size since 2010 — from
  roughly 70,000 to over 150,000 registered foundations, most of them small family
  foundations rather than the mega-funds that dominate the news.
</p>
<div class="phil-wrap">
  <canvas id="phil-foundations" height="320"></canvas>
</div>
<p class="phil-note">
  Number of private foundations registered in the United States. 2011 and 2015 figures
  from the Foundation Center; 2023&#8211;2025 figures from Candid. Intermediate years are
  estimated via smoothed interpolation.
</p>

<!-- ── CHART 3: GLOBAL BILLIONAIRES ── -->
<p class="phil-h2">3 &mdash; Number of Billionaires Worldwide</p>
<p class="phil-desc">
  The billionaire population has grown in step with — and arguably faster than — both
  the foundation sector and the Giving Pledge. Global billionaire wealth has surged 81%
  since 2020 alone, reaching an estimated $18.3 trillion in 2025.
</p>
<div class="phil-wrap">
  <canvas id="phil-billionaires" height="320"></canvas>
</div>
<p class="phil-note">
  Number of individuals with net worth over $1 billion, worldwide. Source: Forbes
  World's Billionaires List (annual), with 2025 figure corroborated by UBS Billionaire
  Ambitions Report. Counts vary slightly by methodology and snapshot date.
</p>

<!-- ── CHART 4: INDEXED COMPARISON ── -->
<p class="phil-h2">4 &mdash; Relative Growth, Indexed to 2010</p>
<p class="phil-desc">
  Putting all three series on the same scale (2010 = 100) shows the real story: the
  Giving Pledge kept pace with billionaire growth for its first decade, but new sign-ups
  have nearly dried up since 2023 even as billionaire wealth and the foundation sector
  continue to expand.
</p>
<div class="phil-wrap">
  <canvas id="phil-indexed" height="320"></canvas>
</div>
<p class="phil-note">
  All three series indexed to 100 at 2010. This normalization shows relative growth
  rates rather than absolute scale &mdash; the underlying populations differ by several
  orders of magnitude (hundreds of signatories vs. thousands of billionaires vs.
  hundreds of thousands of foundations).
</p>

<script>
(function(){

Chart.defaults.font.family = "'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif";
Chart.defaults.color = '#94a3b8';

var YEARS = [2010,2011,2012,2013,2014,2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024,2025];

// Cumulative Giving Pledge signatories
var PLEDGE = [57,69,80,92,103,113,128,144,160,175,185,220,230,238,252,256];

// US private foundations (count)
var FOUNDATIONS = [70000,73764,77000,80000,83500,86203,91000,96000,102000,108000,
                    114000,122000,132000,141000,147000,151011];

// Global billionaires (Forbes annual count)
var BILLIONAIRES = [1011,1210,1226,1426,1645,1826,1810,2043,2208,2153,
                     2095,2755,2668,2640,2781,2891];

var COMMON_TOOLTIP = {
  backgroundColor: '#060c1a', borderColor: '#1e2d45', borderWidth: 1,
  titleColor: '#64748b', bodyColor: '#e2e8f0', padding: 10
};

var COMMON_X = {
  grid: { color: '#111d30' },
  ticks: { color: '#4a6080', font: { size: 11 } }
};

function makeLineChart(canvasId, data, color, label, yFormat, yLabel) {
  var ctx = document.getElementById(canvasId).getContext('2d');
  return new Chart(ctx, {
    type: 'line',
    data: {
      labels: YEARS,
      datasets: [{
        label: label,
        data: data,
        borderColor: color,
        backgroundColor: color + '22',
        borderWidth: 2.5,
        tension: 0.35,
        fill: true,
        pointRadius: 3,
        pointHoverRadius: 6,
        pointBackgroundColor: color,
        pointBorderColor: color
      }]
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
      plugins: {
        legend: { display: false },
        tooltip: Object.assign({}, COMMON_TOOLTIP, {
          callbacks: {
            label: function(c) {
              return ' ' + label + ': ' + yFormat(c.parsed.y);
            }
          }
        })
      },
      scales: {
        x: COMMON_X,
        y: {
          grid: { color: '#111d30' },
          ticks: {
            color: '#4a6080', font: { size: 11 },
            callback: function(v){ return yFormat(v); }
          },
          title: { display: true, text: yLabel, color: '#4a6080', font: { size: 11 } }
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

makeLineChart('phil-pledge', PLEDGE, '#60a5fa', 'Signatories',
  function(v){ return Math.round(v); }, 'Cumulative signatories');

makeLineChart('phil-foundations', FOUNDATIONS, '#4ade80', 'Foundations',
  function(v){ return (v/1000).toFixed(0) + 'k'; }, 'Number of foundations');

makeLineChart('phil-billionaires', BILLIONAIRES, '#facc15', 'Billionaires',
  function(v){ return Math.round(v).toLocaleString(); }, 'Number of billionaires');

// ── Indexed comparison chart ──
function indexSeries(arr) {
  var base = arr[0];
  return arr.map(function(v){ return (v/base)*100; });
}

var idxCtx = document.getElementById('phil-indexed').getContext('2d');
new Chart(idxCtx, {
  type: 'line',
  data: {
    labels: YEARS,
    datasets: [
      {
        label: 'Giving Pledge signatories',
        data: indexSeries(PLEDGE),
        borderColor: '#60a5fa',
        backgroundColor: '#60a5fa22',
        borderWidth: 2.5, tension: 0.35,
        pointRadius: 3, pointHoverRadius: 6,
        pointBackgroundColor: '#60a5fa', pointBorderColor: '#60a5fa'
      },
      {
        label: 'US foundations',
        data: indexSeries(FOUNDATIONS),
        borderColor: '#4ade80',
        backgroundColor: '#4ade8022',
        borderWidth: 2.5, tension: 0.35,
        pointRadius: 3, pointHoverRadius: 6,
        pointBackgroundColor: '#4ade80', pointBorderColor: '#4ade80'
      },
      {
        label: 'Global billionaires',
        data: indexSeries(BILLIONAIRES),
        borderColor: '#facc15',
        backgroundColor: '#facc1522',
        borderWidth: 2.5, tension: 0.35,
        pointRadius: 3, pointHoverRadius: 6,
        pointBackgroundColor: '#facc15', pointBorderColor: '#facc15'
      }
    ]
  },
  options: {
    responsive: true,
    interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
    plugins: {
      legend: {
        position: 'bottom',
        labels: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 12 }, padding: 16, boxWidth: 20 }
      },
      tooltip: Object.assign({}, COMMON_TOOLTIP, {
        callbacks: {
          label: function(c) {
            return ' ' + c.dataset.label + ': ' + c.parsed.y.toFixed(0) + ' (2010=100)';
          }
        }
      })
    },
    scales: {
      x: COMMON_X,
      y: {
        grid: { color: '#111d30' },
        ticks: { color: '#4a6080', font: { size: 11 },
          callback: function(v){ return v; }
        },
        title: { display: true, text: 'Index (2010 = 100)', color: '#4a6080', font: { size: 11 } }
      }
    }
  }
});

})();
</script>
```

---

**Sources:** Giving Pledge signatory data compiled from givingpledge.org, the Institute
for Policy Studies report "The Giving Pledge at 15" (2025), and reporting by CNBC, NBC
News, and Nonprofit Quarterly (2025). US private foundation counts from the Foundation
Center (2011, 2015) and Candid (2023&#8211;2025). Global billionaire counts from Forbes
World's Billionaires List, with 2025 wealth figures corroborated by the UBS Billionaire
Ambitions Report. Year-by-year figures not anchored to a published source are
interpolated estimates.
